Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    varBusy
    || CountRows(Filter(colHomeQueue As queueItem, Lower(Text(queueItem.source)) = "sharepoint")) > 0,
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    DisplayMode.Edit
)

If(
    varBusy
    || IsBlank(
        Coalesce(
            If(!IsBlank(varImage) && varImage <> SampleImage, varImage, Blank()),
            If(
                !IsBlank(varImageUrl),
                Coalesce(LookUp(colHomeQueue, id = varHomeSelectedId).image, varImageUrl),
                Blank()
            )
        )
    ),
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    DisplayMode.Edit
)

If(
    varBusy
    || IsBlank(
        Coalesce(
            If(!IsBlank(varImage) && varImage <> SampleImage, varImage, Blank()),
            If(
                !IsBlank(varImageUrl),
                Coalesce(LookUp(colHomeQueue, id = varHomeSelectedId).image, varImageUrl),
                Blank()
            )
        )
    ),
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    DisplayMode.Edit
)
